title: Objective
description: M2 spec objective shape. `kind` enumerates the per-mission action verb; `progress` is the canonical 0.0..1.0 fraction the spec's PROGRESS_QUARTILES driver consumes.

kind.description: ObjectiveKind tag — one of BreachBarrier, NeutralizeActor, ReachZone, DefendReactor, SurviveTimer, EscortActor.

progress.description: Continuous progress fraction. PROGRESS_QUARTILES = [0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0] drives mission.objective_updated emission.

fail_sensor.description: Optional fail-sensor descriptor (e.g. {kind: timer, threshold_ticks: 5400}). Currently informational; the engine's mission step() inspects the kind directly.
